newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock sets HK$4.5 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock sets HK$4.5 bln loan.

text.p: Syndication for Wheelock and Co's loan facility is expected to be closed on April 7, bankers said on Wednesday.
The borrowing amount has been increased to HK$4.5 billion from HK$3 billion due to oversubscription in the underwriting stage.
The loan matures in three years but can be extended at the borrower's option to five years, they said.
The loan pays an interest margin of 50 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.

Management fees are 35 basis points for lead managers committing HK$150 to HK$180 million, 32.5 basis points for co-lead managers committing HK$100 million to HK$120 million, and 30 basis points for managers committing HK$70 million.
Arrangers include ABN Amro, Chase Manhattan Asia and Hang Seng Bank.
Proceeds are to be used for general working capital.
